name: RF jamming of C2 links
description: Jammer raises J/S on the UAV's C2 receivers until links degrade or deny, forcing lost-link behavior.

name: GNSS spoofing
description: Counterfeit GNSS signals drag the perceived position away from truth at a rate below detector thresholds.

name: False telemetry injection (data poisoning)
description: Forged telemetry reaches the GCS so operators decide on false data.

name: Malware in flight control software via compromised signed update
description: A compromised build carries a valid signature through delivery and is loaded onto the flight computer.

name: Stolen maintenance credential
description: A valid maintenance credential enables exfiltration or sabotage depending on its privilege.

name: Ransomware on GCS / C2 servers
description: Ransomware disables ground control and C2 services and destroys or encrypts mission records.
